# Get the departures generated by frequencies entries

Expands each entry of a `frequencies` table into its departures, every
`headway_secs` from `start_time` until (but not including) `end_time`,
as required by the GTFS specification. An entry whose `start_time` and
`end_time` are equal generates a single departure. Only the unique
departures of each trip are kept. Raises an error if any entry is
invalid.

## Usage

``` r
get_frequencies_departures(freqs)
```

## Arguments

- freqs:

  A `data.table` with the columns `trip_id`, `start_time_secs`,
  `end_time_secs` and `headway_secs` (all but `trip_id` integers).

## Value

A `data.table` with the columns `trip_id` and `departure_secs`.
